// Safe getter function const g = (path, fallback="N/A") => { try { const parts = path.split("."); let v = $node["Rubric Generator"].json; for (const p of parts) v = v[p]; return (v === undefined || v === null || Number.isNaN(v)) ? fallback : v; } catch { return fallback; } }; // Helper: numeric fallback (0) const n = (path) => Number(g(path, 0)); const totalScore = n("totalScore"); // Build HTML safely const html = ` Rubric Report

Rubric Evaluation Report

Automatically Generated

Overall Score: ${totalScore}/100

Criteria Score Details
Content & Structure ${n("scores.content.total")}/40 Salutation: ${n("scores.content.salutationScore")}, Mandatory: ${n("scores.content.mandatoryScore")}, Good-to-Have: ${n("scores.content.gthScore")}, Flow: ${n("scores.content.flowScore")}
Speech Rate ${n("scores.speech.wpmScore")}/10 ${n("scores.speech.wpm")} WPM
Grammar ${n("scores.grammar.grammarScore")}/10 Errors: ${n("scores.grammar.grammarErrors")}, Errors/100 words: ${n("scores.grammar.errorsPer100")}, Ratio: ${n("scores.grammar.grammarRatio")}
Vocabulary (TTR) ${n("scores.vocabulary.vocabScore")}/10 TTR: ${n("scores.vocabulary.TTR")}
Clarity (Fillers) ${n("scores.clarity.clarityScore")}/15 Fillers: ${n("scores.clarity.fillerCount")}, Rate: ${n("scores.clarity.fillerRate")}%
Engagement ${n("scores.engagement.engagementScore")}/15 Label: ${g("scores.engagement.sentimentLabel", "neutral")}, Score: ${n("scores.engagement.positiveProb")}

Comments

  • Content & Structure: ${g("comments.contentComment")}
  • Grammar: ${g("comments.languageComment")}
  • Vocabulary: ${g("comments.vocabComment")}
  • Clarity: ${g("comments.fluencyComment")}
  • Engagement: ${g("comments.engagementComment")}

Generated on ${new Date().toLocaleString()}

`; return [{ html }];
